applicabilityBasis.summary: XGZ references one gram of physical gold and provides conditional gold-bar redemption. Gold is not national-currency monetary value under GENIUS Act section 2(17), so the token does not satisfy the fixed-monetary-value payment-stablecoin definition in section 2(22).

references.label: GENIUS Act section 2(22) payment stablecoin definition
GoldZip terms: gold-bar redemption and no cash-value claim

genius.notes: XGZ references physical gold, not national-currency monetary value. The 15 October 2026 issuer notice announces GoldZip Company Limited (British Virgin Islands company 2056034) replacing GoldZip Pte Limited (Singapore UEN 202119587H), with execution dated 15 October subject to lawful implementation. These issuer fields record the announced successor, not independent proof that every novation or release is complete. The Ethereum contract is unchanged and no token swap is required. The notice preserves accrued claims and says the Singapore issuer is not released without the required consent or legal basis. Separate ordinary terms name GoldZip Digital Pte Ltd (UEN 202119588Z) as administrator/redemption counterparty. Ordinary terms deny proprietary bar interests; the additional special exit permits whole-balance USDT redemption after timely election by 5 November 2026 at 23:59 UTC, with issuer-determined pricing and conditional settlement within 14 Business Days after that deadline. The notice waives a cited ordinary 0.25% fee, which differs from the Rules' per-bar schedule; ordinary fee precedence is unresolved. No exact GoldZip match was found in MinLaw's dealer list as at 2026-10-12; registration is not asserted and its AML/CFT/CPF remit is not prudential supervision. No GENIUS authorization is asserted. MiCA remains independently unassessed because an exact EU offering/authorization posture is not established.
